featured_reviews.name: abhijeet more
featured_reviews.review_text: We are very satisfied with the teaching pedagogy of Montessori. Our ward is currently in Nursery and is doing very well . He has completed his playschool from Montessori too. He has got his best friends in Montessori only.

featured_reviews.name: Azhar Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a parent, I was looking for the best preschool in our area when I came to know about Montessori Hour. Initially, I was a bit skeptical since I had limited knowledge about the Montessori method. However, when we visited the school, the staff gave us a detailed introduction to the concept and patiently cleared all our doubts.

From the very first day to the end of the year, the teachers, support staff, and non-teaching staff were extremely caring and supportive. They made the settling period smooth for my child and ensured that every child felt comfortable and happy. My child was always excited to go to school and learned so much throughout the year — the overall development was truly wonderful.

The school environment is thoughtfully designed, keeping in mind every area of a child’s development. We especially appreciated the weekly progress updates, which helped us understand how our child was growing in different aspects. As working parents, we also noticed a positive change in our child’s habits — learning to tidy up, organize things properly, and take responsibility — something we had been struggling with earlier.

A special thanks to the Principal for organizing events that involve parents and grandparents, making the school feel like an extended family.

As a family, we highly recommend Montessori Hour to any parent looking for a nurturing, structured, and enriching environment for their child’s early years.

featured_reviews.name: Jinal Shah-Choksi
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a parent, finding a perfect learning environment that truly respects the individuality of each child is like searching for a needle in a haystack. But this Montessori is different from the rest. It’s not just a school—it’s a sanctuary where children are gently guided to discover their strengths, build foundational skills, and grow into confident, curious learners.

What sets this Montessori apart is its deep understanding that every child blooms in their own time. There’s no pressure to race ahead or compete. Instead, the educators foster a calm, encouraging space where kids are free to explore, ask questions, and learn at a pace that feels right for them. While some parents think that their child should learn and do things because they go to playgroup/montessori, a lot depends on what a child gets at home as well. In any case, to each is their own and this Montessori is definitly a place I strongly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Khushboo Jangid

My experience with Montessori Hour, under the expert guidance of Miss Seeta, has been one of the most valuable learning journeys I’ve had. The training sessions are thoughtfully designed, providing a perfect blend of theory and hands-on practice. Each session reflects a deep understanding of Montessori philosophy and its true application in the classroom.

Miss Seeta’s way of teaching is inspiring — she explains every concept with patience, clarity, and real-life examples that make learning meaningful and enjoyable. She ensures that every trainee feels confident and supported throughout the program. Her calm and encouraging nature creates a comfortable environment where we can freely ask questions and share our thoughts.

What I appreciate most is how Montessori Hour focuses not just on the academic side, but also on understanding the child’s inner world — helping us see education as a process of nurturing independence, curiosity, and joy in every child.

I feel truly grateful to be trained under Miss Seeta’s mentorship. This experience has not only strengthened my knowledge of Montessori education but has also helped me grow personally and professionally. Montessori Hour truly stands out as a place where genuine Montessori principles are practiced and taught with dedication.
